predecessors.name: Early Cheras
predecessors.text: the Chera country of Karur, claimed descent from the legendary pre-Pallava Cheras

successors.name: Chola Empire
successors.text: 'the Kongu country was conquered by the Cholas under Aditya I in the final years of the 9th century AD'

ledger.x: c. 700: Karur emerges as the main Chera seat. The page gives no founding date; 'Karur had gained prominence over the other two bases' in the 8th-9th centuries.
c. 895: 'the Kongu country was conquered by the Cholas under Aditya I in the final years of the 9th century AD'.
c. 895: independent Kongu Chera rule ends; later rulers governed under the Cholas.

certainty.note: No dates or frontier on the page; extent is the four modern districts.
